video.title: Sample: a melodic street trap type beat

result.vibe: Cinematic, triumphant and bittersweet: spacious atmospheric synths over hard-hitting trap drums.

drums.kick: Punchy trap kick on key downbeats and a few syncopated bounce spots, supporting the 808 without overplaying.
drums.snare_clap: Crisp clap layered on beat 3 of each bar (the half-time backbeat).
drums.hi_hats: Steady driving closed hats with quick triplet or stutter rolls every couple of bars.
drums.percussion: Open hats and soft crashes marking the start of each 8-bar phrase and drop.
drums.groove: Spacious half-time bounce with a head-nodding pocket that leaves room for vocals.

result.bass_808: Warm, slightly saturated 808 following the chord roots with long sustained hits and the odd octave jump or slide at phrase turnarounds.

melody.lead_sound: Glassy bell/pluck synth over wide, lush string-like pads.
melody.approach: A simple, catchy, repeating motif over an 8-bar loop that keeps the midrange open.
melody.harmony: An emotional minor progression with a dark-but-uplifting feel (think i - VI - VII).
melody.layers: Atmospheric pad bed, bright bell motif, and a higher shimmering layer that enters later for lift.

arrangement.what_happens: Pads and bell melody set the mood; a subtle riser leads into the first drop.
Full drums, 808 and melody slam in together with an open-hat/crash impact.
Drums and 808 keep rolling while a subtle high synth adds movement without crowding vocals.
808 and main drums drop out, leaving chords and bells to rebuild tension.
Full beat returns for a strong final hook and rides out.

mix_notes: Cut lows below about 120-150 Hz on pads and bells so they never clash with the 808.
Keep kick, clap and 808 centered; spread the pads wide.
Sit the hats a little under the clap and vary their velocity so they don't sound harsh.
A soft clipper on the master lets the kick and 808 hit hard without clipping.

fl_studio_sounds.suggestion: FLEX warm pad or strings preset, or a Sytrus string pad, with Fruity Reeverb 2
FLEX bell, celesta or music-box preset, or a Sytrus FM bell with Fruity Delay 3
3x Osc soft sine/triangle lead, or a FLEX pluck an octave up
A stock FL Studio trap 808 sample, or FLEX Hard 808s
Stock trap kit: tight kick, crisp clap, short closed hat, open hat, crash

boothmate_prompts: Set the tempo to 180 BPM and add markers for a 16-bar Intro, 16-bar Hook, 16-bar Verse and 8-bar Breakdown.
Write a lush, emotional 8-bar chord progression in D minor with a i-VI-VII feel on my pad channel.
Write a simple, catchy bell melody in D minor that sits above the chords without crowding the midrange.
Program a half-time trap drum pattern: clap on beat 3, steady closed hats with a few quick rolls, an open hat on bar 1, and a punchy syncopated kick.
Write an 8-bar 808 in D minor that follows the chord roots with long notes and a subtle octave slide at the end of bar 8.
Clone the drum and melody patterns so I can build a stripped-down breakdown with just chords and bells.
Name my mixer tracks Pad, Bell, Kick, Clap, Hi-Hats, Open Hat and 808, keep kick, clap and 808 centered, and pan the hats and bells slightly.
result.notes: Clean instrumental with a short producer tag in the intro. Bar counts are at 180 BPM; working at 90 BPM, halve them.
